description: Read recent output from a session, newest last. Use filter to grep for an error: it searches all retained output and returns the last `tail` matching lines. Works for a currently running session id, and for a past run (its own session id, or the runId from list_run_history) even after it has stopped or the daemon has restarted.

session.description: A live session id, or a past run's session id / runId.

tail.description: How many lines (default 200); with a filter, how many matching lines.

name: read_logs
